propositions: _pai_check_config currently raises a loud refusal on any base_url or api_key configuration, despite documentation and config parsing supporting them
An openai builder must be registered in the provider factory to construct OpenAIChatModel with a custom base_url, gated behind pydantic-ai-slim[openai] extra and triggered only when base_url is set
The builder must override the provider's model_profile to withdraw supports_json_schema_output=False for opaque endpoints, preventing silent wrong answers from incompatible servers
base_url is provider configuration not provider selection; REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER explicitly chooses the provider while base_url only decides whether rebar or pydantic-ai constructs it
A bare openai:gpt-4o string without base_url must continue taking the lazy model-string path for backward compatibility and to keep the openai SDK optional at runtime
